##### Project general facts

Divine Al Barari Residences is a masterpiece of residential development, where residents can live surrounded by lush greenery, shimmering water features, and warm evening light. This exceptional project offers a thoughtfully curated range of residences, including Studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, two-bedroom with Study, two-bedroom with Maid's Room, three-bedroom, and three-bedroom Duplex Penthouses, each designed to feel like a private retreat. Rising graciously across seventeen floors with a total of two hundred and ninety-one residences, Divine Al Barari Residences is a community where every home breathes with nature and the rhythms of daily life feel effortless, with residences boasting elegant outdoor spaces and cutting-edge amenities.

The amenities at Divine Al Barari Residences are truly resort-calibre, offering residents an extraordinary array of spaces to move, pause, and connect, including a mixed-use gym, outdoor gym, yoga area, jogging track, multi-purpose sports court, mini golf, table tennis, and archery area, all woven into beautifully landscaped surroundings. Water lovers are equally spoilt with a stunning beach pool, lap pool, kids' pool, jacuzzis, saunas, and splash pads, while leisure seekers can unwind in cabanas, a sunken seating lounge, a residents' café, party lounge, viewing deck, and sundeck. A dedicated co-working space, twenty-four-hour concierge, and security services ensure that every aspect of community life runs smoothly and with care, providing residents with a luxurious and wholesome experience.

Inside each residence, the design philosophy is one of calm luxury and timeless elegance, with high ceilings lifting the sense of space, while full-height windows flood interiors with natural light and frame panoramic views of the green surroundings. Kitchens are crafted for both intimate mornings and lively gatherings, featuring marble islands that double as generous dining surfaces, and bathrooms are spa-inspired sanctuaries, finished in rich marble cladding with rain showers that turn everyday routines into indulgent rituals. Select residences feature private pools on expansive balconies, bringing the resort experience directly to residents' doorsteps, a true testament to the refined quality of life at Divine Al Barari Residences, with modern finishing and high-quality materials used throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a vast and rapidly evolving district, boasting an impressive array of residential complexes, iconic towers, hotels, and mixed-use units. With its strategic location at the heart of the large Dubailand community, Majan offers residents easy access to major roads, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road, providing a convenient gateway to Al Ain, Sharjah, and Abu Dhabi. The area's excellent infrastructure and proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, and sports facilities make it an attractive destination for locals and tourists alike.

Majan's unique charm lies in its affordable prices, which attract a wide range of residents and investors, from families to young professionals, looking for a comfortable and convenient place to live. The community's proximity to major amusement parks and sports facilities also makes it an ideal location for those who enjoy an active lifestyle, with plenty of opportunities to engage in outdoor activities and entertainment. As the community continues to develop, residents can enjoy a wide range of amenities and services, from restaurants and cafes to shops and recreational facilities.

The main advantage of Majan is its strategic location, which provides residents with easy access to all parts of the emirate, while also offering a more affordable alternative to the seashore or central parts of Dubai. With its excellent infrastructure and wide range of amenities, Majan is rapidly becoming a popular destination for those looking for a comfortable and convenient place to live, with a unique blend of natural beauty, modern amenities, and traditional charm.
